audit.why: win[] matches packet.levelChart at all seven stages (Skill / Ambessa / Ambessa / Skill / Ambessa / Ambessa / Sion) and each whys[] entry argues the same side. There is no full layer to disagree with it.
audit.corrected: No chart change. Stage prose corrected instead where it named the wrong mechanic.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said only 'her R gives her chain CC' with no name and no cooldown, so nothing told you how long the punish window is.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s at 1250 range: it blinks to the farthest champion in the chosen line, suppresses on arrival, then slams for damage and a stun.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and whys[4] now name Public Execution, its blink-to-farthest targeting, the suppression, and the 130s cooldown that defines your safe window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors. Text said Ambessa 'shreds your armor with E' — Lacerate has no armour shred. And it said her dash 'comes online' at level 2 — Drakehound's Step is a passive available from level 1.
audit.why: Riot text: Lacerate whips her drakehounds around her for damage and a slow; the second strike comes from initiating Drakehound's Step out of it. Drakehound's Step triggers whenever she queues an attack or move command while casting any ability, so she can dash off Cunning Sweep at level 1 — she just only has one cast to spend.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], early, mid and wants.foe[2] restated: Lacerate slows, Cunning Sweep transforms into Sundering Slam, and the dash is gated by how many casts she has rather than by level.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that releasing a charged swing into Repudiation makes it worse.
audit.why: Repudiation shields her, braces, then slams — and Riot's text says the slam deals increased damage if she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing. Dumping your charge into the brace feeds it.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] now tells you to hold the swing until the brace ends.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line despite Public Execution carrying a heal.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup on Public Execution.
audit.corrected: whys[4] states it heals her through the burst; mid tells you to have anti-heal before long fights.

edits.before: Neither champion has a clear level-1 edge — she cannot dash yet and your Q charge time keeps her at range; trade Q-tip poke only.
edits.after: Neither has a clear level-1 edge — Drakehound's Step only dashes off an ability cast, so she has one, and your Q tip keeps her honest.

edits.before: Her dash comes online and lets her sidestep your charged-Q telegraph on demand; she trades freely while you charge.
edits.after: With two abilities she chains Drakehound's Step dashes around your charge telegraph and trades freely while you wind up.

edits.before: With her full basic combo she shreds your armor with E, dashes your Q, and wins every extended trade — take minimal chip and bank W.
edits.after: Her full combo lands at 3: Lacerate slows, Sundering Slam follows Cunning Sweep, and she dashes your Q — take chip and bank Soul Furnace.

edits.before: Her R chain CC gives her a full-burst all-in combo that fires before your W can fully absorb it; play for R as a gank anchor, not a solo kill.
edits.after: Public Execution suppresses, slams and stuns on a 130s cooldown and heals her through the burst; play your R as a gank anchor, not a solo kill.

edits.before: Ambessa's R gives her chain CC and a full burst combo; she owns the all-in unless your W shield absorbs the first rotation.
edits.after: Public Execution blinks to the farthest target, suppresses and stuns; she owns the all-in unless Soul Furnace eats the rotation.

edits.before: Pop W-shield to absorb her first dash-combo rotation before committing to a brawl
edits.after: Hold the charged swing until Repudiation's brace ends, or you feed its bonus damage

edits.before: Shred your armor with E and chain dashes to prevent you ever landing a stun
edits.after: Slow you with Lacerate and chain Drakehound's Step so you never land a stun

edits.before: At level 1 you both feel each other out — her dash is not yet online and your Q charge is the only real threat, but she respects it enough to stay out of full-charge range. Farm safely under the Q tip and do not commit a full wind-up unless she walks straight at you with no room to dash. The moment she hits level 2 her dash lets her sidestep your telegraph on demand, so she starts poking freely; pre-pop your W-shield before walking up to last-hit under pressure. By level 3 she has her full basic rotation and is winning every short trade — accept the chip, keep W for her combo, and stay healthy for level 6.
edits.after: At level 1 you both feel each other out — Drakehound's Step only fires off an ability cast, so she has one dash in her, and your Q charge is the only real threat. Farm safely under the Q tip and do not commit a full wind-up unless she walks straight at you with no room to dash. By level 2 she has enough casts to dash around your telegraph on demand, so she starts poking freely; pre-pop Soul Furnace before walking up to last-hit under pressure. By level 3 she has her full basic rotation and is winning every short trade — accept the chip, keep W for her combo, and stay healthy for level 6.

edits.before: At levels 4-5 you have your full kit but no power spike, and she is still dodging your charged Q with her dash while taking favorable short trades; this is her window to build a lead, so play at max charged-Q range and only use E armor-shred to set up a stun you are confident will land. Level 6 is still hers — her R combo deals a burst of chain CC that can kill you before your zombie passive becomes relevant, and your R is better as an escape or ganksync tool than a 1v1 engage. Focus on not bleeding gold and keep the wave managed so her lead stays minimal entering the item phase.
edits.after: At levels 4-5 you have your full kit but no power spike, and she is still dashing off your charged Q while taking favorable short trades; this is her window to build a lead, so play at max charged-Q range and spend Roar of the Slayer's armour shred only to set up a stun you are confident will land. Level 6 is still hers — Public Execution suppresses you out of every answer before your zombie passive matters, and your R is better as an escape or ganksync tool than a 1v1 engage. Buy Grievous Wounds before the fights get long, stop bleeding gold, and keep the wave managed.

notes: No full-layer entry exists for this matchup, so all edits are content-layer and the chart lives in win[] alone — it already agrees with the packet at all seven stages, so I left it. Two fabrications removed: Lacerate does not shred armour, and Drakehound's Step is not a level-2 unlock. Added the Repudiation brace interaction, which is the single most punishable thing a Sion does in this lane.
